description: Reactory multi-repo inventory: every git repository that makes up a Reactory checkout, where it lives on disk, and the upstream organisation that owns it. Enterprise mirrors are declared in profiles/<name>.json.
// profiles: Enterprise profiles live in enterprises/<name>/profile.json (separate, gitignored repos); select with --profile or REACTORY_PROFILE. A single present enterprise is selected automatically.

upstream_org.// protected: Default branch protected by policies/public-upstream.json: sync into it goes through a sync/ branch and a PR, never a direct push.

groups.platform: Required to build and deploy the Reactory server + PWA client
groups.optional: Not needed for a deployment of the platform
groups.tooling: Workspace tooling: not part of a deployment, upstream-only
